title: Downtown Rooftop Sleeps 10 Near Gulch and 12 South
description:
Perfectly located between 12 South and The Gulch, this modern Nashville retreat sleeps 10 comfortably across 3 stories plus a rooftop with skyline views and lounge seating. Ideal for groups looking to stay close to the best dining, shopping, and nightlife in Music City and only 10 minutes to Broadway. Most importantly, we have free parking!

Sleeping Arrangements:
-Primary bedroom: king Bed 
-Bedroom 2:  twin over twin bunk, queen over queen bunk
-Bedroom 3: king bed
